answer: Each signing key is rate-limited to 3 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own dune proof, and each must still clear the ocean grading gate to earn. The mesa counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient attacker can outlast. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
